gloss: shoulder width; breadth of the shoulders

definitions.gloss: shoulder width; breadth of the shoulders
definitions.explanation: The distance across a person's shoulders. Used when describing build, fitting clothes, or body measurements.

examples.japanese: {肩幅|かたはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a jacket to fit my shoulder width.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肩幅|かたはば}くらい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, your body is stable.

notes:
The width across the shoulders. Commonly mentioned when describing someone's physique or when choosing clothing that fits well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肩幅|かたはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: to have broad shoulders
- {肩幅|かたはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧: to have narrow shoulders
- {肩幅|かたはば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to spread (the feet) shoulder-width apart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {身幅|みはば}: body width (of a garment) — a clothing measurement across the torso
- ⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: build; physique — the overall body frame, broader than just the shoulders
